lines: Dobbins' role has shrunk. He played 12% of snaps and averaged 4.0 carries over his last 3 games, compared with 32% of snaps and 9.9 carries on the season.
He averaged 1.5 PPR points per game over his last 3 games, down from 6.2 on the season. He has 3 total TDs this year.
Coach Sean Payton said Dobbins will not play in Week 12 at Pittsburgh because of a team suspension.
